seo.title: Talks & workshops – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Talks and workshops for clubs, teams and groups: nutrition around training and competition, sustainable training and my path to long distance.

title: Talks & workshops
lead: I also share what I know with clubs, teams and groups. For example, I gave a talk to a basketball team about nutrition around training and game day.
imageCaption: Talk for a basketball team: nutrition around training and game day.

topics.title: Nutrition around training and competition
topics.text: What should I eat before, during and after training? And what does fuelling look like on game day or race day?

topics.title: Getting better sustainably
topics.text: How training load and recovery work together, and why the easy days matter as much as the hard ones.

topics.title: My path to long distance
topics.text: From my first run in 2020 to Challenge Roth: what I learned about training, motivation and myself along the way.

formats.title: Talk
formats.text: A compact session with time for your questions. A good fit for team evenings or club events.

formats.title: Workshop
formats.text: We work together on concrete questions from your everyday training.

formats.title: By arrangement
formats.text: We'll agree on topic, length and format so it suits you.

ctaText: Tell me who the talk is for and which topic interests you. I'll get back to you with a suggestion.
